# crosswork_aaa_ldap_servers (Resource)

This resource can manage the LDAP servers used for authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_aaa_ldap_servers" "example" {
  servers = [
    {
      name                       = "cwtest-ldap"
      ldap_url                   = "ldap://192.0.2.30:389"
      bind_dn                    = "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org"
      bind_credential_wo         = "AAASecret"
      bind_credential_wo_version = 1
      base_dn                    = "dc=example,dc=org"
      user_filter                = "uid={user}"
      dn_format                  = "uid=%s,dc=example,dc=org"
      principal_attribute_id     = "uid"
      policy_id                  = "crossworkPolicyId"
      order                      = 50
      connect_timeout            = 5
    }
  ]
  attribute_servers = [
    {
      ldap_url                   = "ldap://192.0.2.30:389"
      base_dn                    = "ou=groups,dc=example,dc=org"
      bind_dn                    = "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org"
      bind_credential_wo         = "AAASecret"
      bind_credential_wo_version = 1
      user_filter                = "memberOf"
      connect_timeout            = 5
      fail_fast                  = false
      attributes                 = { crossworkPolicyId = "policy_id" }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `attribute_servers` (Attributes List) LDAP servers that look up the role of a user, one for each server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_servers))
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `servers` (Attributes List) LDAP servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_servers`

Required:

- `attributes` (Map of String) Map of the directory key that carries the role to `policy_id`
- `base_dn` (String) Distinguished name where the search for the role starts
- `bind_dn` (String) Distinguished name used to bind to the server
- `connect_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds
- `ldap_url` (String) URL of the server, `ldap://` followed by host and port
- `user_filter` (String) Attribute of the directory that maps the user to its role

Optional:

- `bind_credential` (String, Sensitive) Password used to bind to the server
  - **Required**: exactly one of `bind_credential` and `bind_credential_wo` must be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `bind_credential_wo` together with `bind_credential_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `bind_credential_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password used to bind to the server
  - **Required**: exactly one of `bind_credential` and `bind_credential_wo` must be set.
- `bind_credential_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `bind_credential_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `fail_fast` (Boolean) Fail at once when the server cannot be reached
  - Default value: `false`


<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Required:

- `base_dn` (String) Distinguished name where the search for users starts
- `bind_dn` (String) Distinguished name used to bind to the server
- `connect_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds
- `dn_format` (String) Format of the distinguished name of a user, with `%s` for the user name
- `ldap_url` (String) URL of the server, `ldap://` or `ldaps://`
- `name` (String) Name of the connection
- `order` (Number) Order of the server among all remote authentication servers
- `policy_id` (String) Attribute of the role mapping in the directory
- `principal_attribute_id` (String) Attribute of the user name in the directory
- `user_filter` (String) Filter that matches the users, with `{user}` for the user name

Optional:

- `bind_credential` (String, Sensitive) Password used to bind to the server
  - **Required**: exactly one of `bind_credential` and `bind_credential_wo` must be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `bind_credential_wo` together with `bind_credential_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `bind_credential_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password used to bind to the server
  - **Required**: exactly one of `bind_credential` and `bind_credential_wo` must be set.
- `bind_credential_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `bind_credential_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_aaa_ldap_servers.example "aaa_ldap_servers"
```
